sourceClaimMap.claim: ASIC's professional registers search allows you to search several registers at once.
You can search the professional registers to find out about a person or an organisation registered or licensed with ASIC to provide a service.
You can search by individual or company name, registration or licence number, ACN or ABN.
The authorisation of a credit representative is of no effect if the authorisation to engage in credit activities is not covered by the licensee's licence.
A caveat is a form of statutory injunction provided for under the Real Property Act 1900 recording a claim to an estate or interest in land.
A caveat prevents the registration of dealings and/or plans (except for certain statutory exceptions and any specifically permitted dealings).
